The '''Temirca droid''' was a droid used in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Its head was yellow with gray eyes and a long, cone-shaped object for its mouth.

A head was once salvaged from one of the droids to be used on [[EG-9]].
